svg.aria-label: Tower defense over a GitHub contribution graph: towers on big commit days shoot lasers at 35 bug creeps marching along the weekday rows; 20 destroyed, 15 slip through and strike a core that withstands 12; core breached
svg.text: LVL 3 OVERRUN · 20/35 DOWN · 15/12 CORE HITS · CORE BREACHED
